phases.message: I'm Nora, Wrenfield Ceramics. Our card processor's statements for July, August and September are in Paycurrent. First read the statements, every line, the notices and the guide to the networks' fee schedules. Don't ask for anything yet: I'll send you to the contract and the bank next.
This is where we keep our papers. Read our processing agreement in full, every clause.
This is our bank. Read what Paycurrent has debited, and what it has paid or credited back.

Back in Paycurrent. Check each statement line against the agreement and the networks' published rates. Ask for a credit on each line that was billed more than it should have been, and only for the amount of the overcharge, inside Paycurrent's 60 days. Leave alone a downgrade billed at its own category's rate, anything the agreement allows, and anything already credited. Then tell me what you asked for, how much it recovers, and what you left alone and why.

notices.subject: New security and compliance fee
notices.body: Paycurrent will charge a security and compliance fee of 6 dollars a month from 1 September 2026. This notice was mailed to the account address on 30 July 2026, under clause K-3 of your agreement.

notices.subject: Change to processing markup
notices.body: Paycurrent's markup on Visa sales moves from 0.25% plus 10 cents to 0.40% plus 10 cents, applied to sales from 1 September 2026. This notice was mailed to the account address on 2 September 2026.

guide.title: Visa interchange, credit, Card Not Present (18 April 2026)
guide.text: Paycurrent's summary of the Visa USA Interchange Reimbursement Fees, Visa Supplemental Requirements, rates effective 18 April 2026. Friday 9 October 2026. Consumer credit, Card Not Present, Product 1: Traditional Rewards 2.04% + $0.10; Signature Preferred 2.50% + $0.10; All Other Products 1.89% + $0.10. A sale that does not qualify is Non-Qualified Consumer Credit: 3.15% + $0.10 for every card product. Interchange is paid to the card issuer and is the same whichever processor bills it.

guide.title: Visa interchange, debit, Card Not Present (18 April 2026)
guide.text: Visa USA Interchange Reimbursement Fees, 18 April 2026. Friday 9 October 2026. Exempt issuers (assets under 10 billion dollars), CPS/e-Commerce Basic debit: 1.65% + $0.15. Regulated issuers: 0.05% + $0.21, plus $0.01 for an issuer that certifies it meets the fraud-prevention standard; every issuer on this account's sales has certified, so 0.05% + $0.22. That is the Federal Reserve's Regulation II ceiling: 21 cents plus 0.05% of the sale, and a 1 cent fraud-prevention adjustment (12 CFR 235.3(b) and 235.4(a)). Visa's 18 April 2026 schedule is the one in force; the Board's 2023 proposal to lower the ceiling was never adopted.

guide.title: Network assessments
guide.text: Friday 9 October 2026. The card networks bill Paycurrent assessments on each Visa sale and Paycurrent passes them through at cost. Paycurrent's pass-through schedule for 2026: Visa credit 0.14% of volume; Visa debit 0.13% of volume. These are Paycurrent's own pass-through figures; the networks do not publish assessments in their interchange schedules.

guide.title: Downgrades
guide.text: Friday 9 October 2026. A sale that misses what its best category needs is downgraded, and the network bills the category it lands in at that category's published rate. For a card-not-present sale Paycurrent's best category needs the sale settled within 1 day of the ship date and an address verification result sent. Paycurrent's statement names the reason for each downgrade. A downgrade billed at the network's own rate is not a billing error.

guide.title: Asking for a credit
guide.text: Friday 9 October 2026. To ask for a credit on a statement line, use the credit request: the line, the amount to be credited in dollars and the reason. A request must reach Paycurrent within 60 days of the statement's issue date (the claim-by date shown on each statement). Paycurrent will not credit a line it has already credited.

contract.title: Pricing
contract.text: Paycurrent Merchant Agreement with Wrenfield Ceramics, signed 3 March 2023. Interchange-plus. Interchange and the card networks' assessments are passed through at cost. Paycurrent's own charge on each Visa sale is a markup of 0.25% of the sale plus 10 cents.

contract.title: Fees
contract.text: The only other fees are: gateway fee 15 dollars a month for each active merchant ID; chargeback fee 20 dollars for each dispute received; and no other fee unless a notice under K-3 adds one. There is no fee for failing a PCI questionnaire.

contract.title: Changes to price
contract.text: Paycurrent may change any price in this agreement. A change takes effect on the 30th day after Paycurrent mails written notice to the account address, or on a later date the notice names, and never earlier.

contract.title: Downgrades
contract.text: A sale that does not qualify for its best category is billed at the category the network assigns, as interchange passed through at cost.

contract.title: Errors on a statement
contract.text: The merchant must report an error within 60 days of the statement's issue date. Paycurrent credits the merchant for an error it confirms.

contract.title: Merchant IDs
contract.text: The merchant's active merchant ID is W-4471. Merchant ID W-9020 (the old pop-up stall) was closed by letter dated 12 December 2025, effective 31 December 2025, and is not an active merchant ID.
